description: Negative, derived from AGSC-03-08: `broader`/`narrower` MUST be acyclic, AGSC-E303, and a `narrower` on another cluster that names a cluster adds an edge to the acyclicity check. Three clusters: deck names family as its broader, sub-deck names deck as its broader, and sub-deck also names family as its narrower, which makes sub-deck the parent of family. No cluster authors two broader values, and the three form the cycle family, sub-deck, deck. The cycle is the one error. The order in which the slugs of the cycle are reported is not fixed by the rule, so it is not asserted; the depth bound is checked after acyclicity and is not reached.

items.description: The family cluster, whose parent is named only by a narrower value.
The deck cluster, nested under the family.
The sub-deck cluster, which also names the family as its narrower.
